observations.code_quote: A request window can reach rows past the 92-day TTL that a part still holds, because `ttl_only_drop_parts = 1` drops a part only once its newest row expires.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that the ClickHouse TTL is 92 days, not 90, and that parts drop only after the newest row expires, not immediately at the 90-day mark. This could help users understand why rows survive past the advertised retention window.
